title: pytest-timeout on extractor-full CI
objective: Add pytest-timeout dependency and wire --timeout=120 --timeout-method=thread into extractor-full CI job to prevent hung tests from burning entire 45-minute job.

changes_made.rationale: pytest-timeout plugin required to enforce per-test timeouts
Per-test 120-second timeout using thread-based mechanism to enforce hard limits on hung subprocess-spawning tests

execution_summary.scope: CI configuration and dependency declaration only; no source code changes

validations.name: pytest-timeout added to dependencies
validations.evidence: Dependency declaration present in pyproject.toml test extras

validations.name: CI YAML contains timeout flags
validations.evidence: Timeout flag added to extractor-full job

validations.name: CI YAML is valid
validations.command: mise exec -- python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci-complete.yml')); print('✅ valid')"

validations.name: Golden tests still pass
validations.evidence: Extractor test contract unchanged by configuration-only change

notes: Timeout flags use thread-based mechanism per requirement. Implementation is configuration-only (no source changes). Timeout value (120 seconds) chosen to catch hung subprocess tests while allowing legitimate slow tests to add @pytest.mark.timeout(...) overrides if needed. Job remains at 45-minute GitHub Actions timeout as outer bound.
